post.description: Checks the account and instrument, stores the order as NEW and queues it for the Trade Executor. Poll GET /api/v1/orders/{orderId} until it is FILLED or REJECTED; funds and holdings are checked then. Without a price the order is priced at the live market price. Limit orders are immediate-or-cancel: when a live price is available, a BUY limit below it or a SELL limit above it is refused with ORD-422; a marketable order fills at the market price, never worse than its limit.
